requirement: Georeferenced landslide/non-landslide labels + constructible/compatible S2 B1–B12 + slope + DEM inputs, geographically independent of L4S train/val chips, with spatial-block splits.

candidates_reviewed.name: Landslide4Sense validation HDF5
candidates_reviewed.reason: Competition chips; no CRS; same geographic family as training (not independent AOI validation).

candidates_reviewed.name: SSRI usgs_landslide_featurestacks v3
candidates_reviewed.reason: Wrong feature contract (13-ch SSRI). Points/absences reused as inventory locations only; stacks rebuilt via STAC.

candidates_reviewed.name: Hokkaido / Iburi landslide dataset (karstCand)
candidates_reviewed.bands: Sentinel-2 + DEM (repo documents S2+DEM; not verified locally as full B1–B12+slope)
candidates_reviewed.reason: Iburi is an L4S study area — spatial leakage vs Landslide4Sense training geography.

candidates_reviewed.name: Nepal U-Net scars (Zenodo 3688363)
candidates_reviewed.independent_of_l4s_train_geo: partial (Nepal; Gorkha also L4S — geographic risk)
candidates_reviewed.reason: RGB only; not 14-band S2+terrain package for DeepSlide.

candidates_reviewed.name: Sen12Landslides (paulhoehn/Sen12Landslides)
candidates_reviewed.bands: S2 B02–B12 (10 bands) + DEM; no B01/B10 as in L4S; slope not native
candidates_reviewed.independent_of_l4s_train_geo: partial (multi-region incl. Italy etc.; overlap with L4S Asia areas unknown without audit)
candidates_reviewed.reason: Band set incompatible without fabricating missing L4S channels; full download is multi-100GB; not used.

candidates_reviewed.name: USGS Landslide Inventories v3 (vector) + STAC construction
candidates_reviewed.labelled: vector inventory points buffered 40 m; in-block pseudo-absences
candidates_reviewed.bands: Constructed 14-band via Planetary Computer S2 L2A + Copernicus DEM/slope
candidates_reviewed.reason: Selected and built under production_gates/gate_a_build/; evaluated at thr=0.5.

verdict_meaning: Independent dataset constructed and evaluated; DeepSlide failed predeclared chip-F1 gates (did not beat slope baseline; F1 0.091 < 0.40).
not_done: Did not treat L4S chip metrics as independent geographic validation
Did not treat Iburi STAC visual coherence as scientific validation
Did not download multi-100GB Sen12Landslides or invent missing bands
Did not tune threshold on the Gate A set
